summary: This page is a starting record for tracking immigration detention issues connected to the Northwest ICE Processing Center in Tacoma, Washington. It gathers sourced facts, reported concerns, open questions, and monitoring categories in one place. It is designed for ongoing updates, not as a single breaking-news story.
why_this_matters: Immigration detention infrastructure can affect court access, legal representation logistics, and local public-service planning in the Pacific Northwest.
